Rih is the worst faculty ever for this course bhai, rih er kache ei course neyar theke na neya hajar gune better, ontoto retake er tk ta toh bachbe. Nile emni retake e nite hobe, ekta ; missing er jonno 3mark kate. Emon mark katbe je curve koreo desired grade pawa impossible.

Rih sir core concepts and theory te focus kore, code temn ekta deyna, dileo choto ekta part likhte dibe. Quiz e 1/2 marks er choto choto short question thake, main ans ta likhte parlei full marks. Mid er Section A te Mcq thake 20ta. And section B written ( 3/5 marks er koyekta question) . Initially question dekhe hard mone hote pare but i can assure class lecture follow korle u can answer these v easily! / Cons: Uni rules maintain korte pochondo kore / 1) class e thik time e dhukte hobe. 1/2 days late is considerable but apni jodi constantly late korte thaken, he will not give the attendance / 2) Class time e sir er dike attention dite hobe. Phone/onno kisu te busy thakle sir apnk notice korbe. / 3) Sir jodi theory ans chay apnk theory tei ans dite hobe. Algorithm chaile algorithm. / Sir ask korlo ei problem ta kivabe solve kora jay, apni solve na likhe code likhe diye ashle sir marks dibena. Cause code to apni mukhosto o kore ashte paren problem ta really na bujhe. He just want to make sure apni depth e giye problem ta k feel kore solve korte partesen kina. / Finally, mid and final er age 2ta assignment dey. Oi type er question e exam e ashe. Kono project ney na.
